name: Dead bug
description: Lying on the back, move the opposite arm and leg while keeping the back flat.

name: Bird dog
description: Extend the opposite arm and leg from all fours, holding a steady spine.

name: Pelvic tilt
description: Lying on the back, gently tilt the pelvis to ease the lower back.

name: Plank
description: Hold a straight line from head to heels with the abs braced.

name: Side plank
description: Hold a straight side line on one forearm, then switch sides.

name: Pallof press
description: Press the band out and hold, resisting the pull to rotate.

name: Hanging knee raise
description: Raise the knees toward the chest without swinging.

name: Russian twist
description: Rotate the trunk with the feet lifted, keeping the back neutral.

name: Ab wheel rollout
description: Roll out from the knees and return under control.
caution: Stop before the lower back arches. Keep the hips in line with the shoulders.

name: Hanging leg raise
description: Raise straight legs from a hang, lowering under control.
caution: Control the lowering. Stop if you feel low back strain or grip pain.

name: Turkish get-up
description: Stand up from the floor with a kettlebell held overhead, one side at a time.
caution: Complex movement with load overhead. Practise with light weight and keep the eyes on the weight.
